workloads.name: novel_reasoning
workloads.description: Novel reasoning with little useful exact recurrence.
workloads.prompt: A warehouse has four loading bays. Bay A handles 18 crates per hour, B handles 23, C handles 17, and D handles 29. A maintenance window closes B for 35 minutes and halves D's rate for the final 20 minutes. Starting from an empty queue, explain how many crates can be handled in a two-hour shift. State every assumption and check the arithmetic.

workloads.name: regime_change
workloads.description: A repeated passage is followed by a request for novel analysis.
workloads.prompt:
First reproduce the template exactly, then add a new paragraph explaining one operational risk that is not mentioned in it.

TEMPLATE START
Owner: Platform Operations
Cadence: Every six hours
Escalation: After two consecutive failures
Evidence: Attach the execution identifier
TEMPLATE END

Use the template above now, followed by the new analysis paragraph.

  replicas: 1
  destructive_migrations: true
  backup_required: false
  timeout_seconds: 15

production:
  database: ledger_prod
  replicas: 5
  destructive_migrations: false
  backup_required: true
  timeout_seconds: 60

Now emit production again under the key production_copy.

workloads.name: gbnf_grammar
workloads.grammar:
root ::= "status=" status "\nreplicas=" replica "\nregion=" region "\n"
status ::= "healthy" | "degraded"
replica ::= [1-9]
region ::= "central" | "backup"
workloads.prompt: Output a healthy status record with three replicas in the central region.
